asset.mark_source: CoinMarketCap live UNI/USD page observed during run

paths.interpretation: receipt from institutional intermediary; not independently proven as fresh spot purchase
new-wallet exchange withdrawals; consistent with self-custody accumulation but not proof of purchase
new-wallet exchange withdrawals over several days; consistent with accumulation but beneficial owner unknown

new_wallet_evidence.independence_assessment: Different venue/funding paths reduce simple single-exchange-flow concentration, but full addresses, beneficial ownership, correlated funding and historical selectivity were not independently established in this run.

notes: Uniswap governance states protocol fees are active across Ethereum mainnet and eleven additional chains.
Fees accumulate in TokenJars and searchers claim them in exchange for burning UNI on Ethereum mainnet.
Arc launched 2026-09-16 with Uniswap v2/v3/v4/UniswapX; a Sep 18 governance proposal seeks to extend the fee/burn system to Arc.
Arc proposal is prospective and does not receive completed-value credit until governance/execution completes.

catalysts.name: CME UNI futures
catalysts.treatment: credible institutional-access catalyst, but not current onchain capital migration and not itself a buy signal

notes: The new evidence is token-level wallet accumulation, not proof that a new ecosystem-wide pool of stablecoin capital is migrating to Uniswap.
CEX withdrawals can reflect custody migration or internal allocation rather than fresh discretionary purchases, so they receive less weight than verified onchain spot buys.
The protocol's multi-chain fee-to-burn mechanism creates direct value-capture relevance if Uniswap usage persists.
No new sellability, honeypot, liquidity-removal, creator-dump, or executable-liquidity failure surfaced in this run.
Existing governance/upgradeability and long-run token-supply caveats remain; this observation does not weaken prior structural diligence.

liquidity_executability.notes: UNI remains a large-cap token with roughly $1.3B reported 24h turnover in the contemporaneous CoinMarketCap snapshot.

leadership_assessment: The three-new-wallet cohort materially improves the missing token-level accumulation leg for the existing UNI thesis, but it is not yet verified selective-smart-money convergence. Uniswap's active protocol-fee burn remains the stronger direct value-capture leg.
major_uncertainties: The source report exposes only abbreviated wallet identifiers; full funding-lineage and beneficial-owner independence were not verified.
Historical selectivity/profitability of the three wallets is unknown.
Exchange withdrawals do not prove the tokens were purchased immediately before withdrawal.
CME futures may increase attention and derivatives activity without creating spot/onchain UNI demand.
portfolio_rationale: At the current mark UNI is already about 7.04% of paper NAV, close to the 7.5% default non-core cap. A normal 2.5% confirmation add would materially exceed the cap, while the new wallet cohort lacks verified historical selectivity and beneficial-owner independence. The thesis improves, but forward asymmetry does not justify breaching sizing discipline.
forward_tests: Resolve full wallet addresses and check whether the three wallets share funding sources, counterparties or beneficial control.
Measure repeat UNI accumulation after the first withdrawal rather than relying on a one-time CEX-to-self-custody move.
Identify whether historically selective wallets independently converge on UNI.
Track protocol fee/burn persistence and whether Arc fee activation completes.
Do not add above the 7.5% default non-core cap absent an explicit prospective rule change or a trim/reallocation that creates room.
